provenance.name: anchored-v8.owner-capsule
provenance.note: The anchored set anchored-v8 (docs/calibration/anchoring.md) with the owner's capsule laid over it: the composition of detergents/finish-powerball-ultimate.json (Finish Powerball Ultimate, desk research, nothing measured: docs/research/detergent-finish-ultimate.md) and the capsule's protease level (liq.xProtease = 0.05; fitted on the owner's washes (owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50: liq.xProtease; owner-wash-02-stacked-plates-eco50: liq.xProtease), at the top of the range the detergent dossier gives). Wash with a dose of 12.9 g (dosing.detergentMass, a machine value). Calibrated on the owner's own machine (docs/calibration/owner-wash-01-calibration.md and docs/calibration/anchoring-v8.md; owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50: prog.soakDuty, soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate; owner-wash-02-stacked-plates-eco50: soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate): prog.soakDuty = 0.8, soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate = 0.000075, held in the anchored set this layer is laid over. The protease is as stable as the registry says (liq.proteaseHalfLife 30 min at 60 C and pH 10.5, 1.7 times as long at the capsule's pH 10.1). No measurement of how long the capsule's protease lasts exists: this is the lower end of a bracket whose upper end is the set with the suffix "stable".
